problem: Ali is taller than Badr. Badr is taller than Chen. Conclusion: Ali is taller than Chen. Does the conclusion necessarily follow from the premises? Answer Yes or No.

formalization.problem_prop: ∀ (a b c : ℤ), a > b → b > c → a > c

theorem final_wf : ∀ (a b c : ℤ), a > b → b > c → a > c := by sorry
theorem final_pos : ∀ (a b c : ℤ), a > b → b > c → a > c := by fv_auto
theorem final_neg : ¬ (∀ (a b c : ℤ), a > b → b > c → a > c) := by fv_auto
